![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

There is a validation discrepancy for `rights_policy_ref` between the row pre-validation and the event post-validation. In `missingCriticalRowFields`, `rights_policy_ref` is only checked to be a plain object, which allows an empty object `{}`. However, in `missingCriticalEventFields`, it is checked to be a non-empty plain object. This discrepancy can cause a row with an empty `rights_policy_ref` to pass initial row validation but fail event validation during event construction. We should update `missingCriticalRowFields` to also reject empty objects for `rights_policy_ref` to ensure consistency.

```suggestion
    if (field === 'rights_policy_ref') return !isPlainObject(value) || Object.keys(value).length === 0;
```

Fixed in f0cf36324: row pre-validation now rejects empty rights_policy_ref objects consistently with event post-validation, with regression coverage for the strict builder and non-throwing tryBuild path.

Fixed in f0cf36324: validateFullBeta3530AttemptEvent now returns stable validation_status/errors metadata including missing_critical_fields and remote_write_fields, and tryBuildFullBeta3530AttemptEvent provides the non-throwing path for validation consumers while buildFullBeta3530AttemptEvent remains fail-closed. Added focused regression coverage.
